format: Studio / Custom and any event: direct identity conflicts
requirement: DanceFlow policy (not a body rule): an official whose account matches a participant of an entry in the contest they would judge or score is blocked at assignment and before ballot acceptance. Ambiguous shared-account matches are REVIEW cases, never proof. Family, household and business relationships are detectable only by declaration.
interpretation_notes: Stricter than NDCA IV.A.8 and the WSDC exceptions by design; never presented as a governing-body requirement. Owner decision OD-05 slice 5. Design only (PR-A): nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
